app.notes: Host Setup, after a full run on a rented server. A step that is running now carries on when you look at another page. A provider's SSH command no longer changes how you log in. A port another program uses on the server no longer stops the launch. The wallet step shows what hosts really pay in fees and how long 1 GNK lasts. Continue opens only when a step is done, and the countdown keeps the second. Monitor/Vote remembers how you voted.
